entry.title: Joining in with brushing teeth
entry.summary: Davies treats brushing as necessary care, with chances for the child to take part and gentle help from an adult. This is her application of Montessori principles, not official Montessori dental guidance.
entry.cue: Your child may want to hold the brush, choose part of the routine, or resist help.
detail: Her examples include choosing a toothbrush, deciding when within the bath routine to brush, and brushing alongside an adult. She treats brushing as necessary care while looking for ways the child can take part.
The adult remains involved: the appendix offers a child the first turn and the adult a turn to finish. The chapter emphasizes gentle, respectful assistance.
